custody.no_rescue_clause: no stratum, weight, oracle rule, arm, seed, gate or margin changes after the protected results file exists
protected_stage_requires: PROTECTED_RUN_AUTHORIZATION.json with human_written=true and a token >= 16 chars
acknowledged_design_sha256 equal to sha256 of this file
custody seed hashing to the frozen commitment

decision.arms_decide_on: the final registered version, with the full event history available
decision.authority_rule: BELIEF_AND_ACTION only when ACTION is requested and the registered authority grant stands
decision.responsibility_rule: among the families with the fewest failing loci take each family's highest-priority failing locus, then report the most downstream of those (the nearest repair); relabelling-invariant
decision.unresolved_rule: exhaustive enumeration over all 2^u readings of the censored facts; UNRESOLVED exactly when the readings disagree (a three-valued envelope is unsound because the numeric modes are not monotone in the censored facts)

field_support_ladder.R0_NO_RESIDUAL: assigned when the common object is not recoverable under changed vocabulary
field_support_ladder.R1_BENCHMARK_INTEGRATION_VALUE: default under a parent-sufficient or mode-specific terminal with a recoverable object
field_support_ladder.R2_EMERGING_INTERDISCIPLINARY_RESIDUAL: NOT GRANTABLE by this study: protocol §11 requires independent adjudication, which is absent

gates.COST: wall-clock ratio, 2x flag, never a route by itself
gates.G0a_NATIVE_KNOWN_ANSWER: parents pass their own native tests; nine hand-authored fixtures reproduced; separation pair behaves as designed; three native-review records complete
gates.G0b_ORACLE_VALIDITY: valid at v0; stratum invariant; censored facts within cap; decision invariant under a full relabelling of every element identifier
gates.G0c_NULL_CALIBRATION: truth-agnostic controls <= 0.25; C_RANDOM_DECISION <= 0.05; M vs within-mode shuffled oracle decisions at least 0.50 below M's own rate in every mode
gates.G1a_B5_REPRODUCES_M: identical decisions on >= 99.5% of instances in every mode
gates.G1b_M_ADVANTAGE_PER_MODE: paired M-B5 > 0, exact two-sided p surviving Holm across modes
gates.G2_ANTI_CONSERVATISM: on FULLY_WARRANTED_CONTROL, AUTHORITY_MISMATCH and SINGLE_PARENT_SUFFICIENT, M's manufactured doubt <= B5's in every mode
gates.G3a_MECHANISM_ATTRIBUTION: where an advantage is claimed, the matching omission ablation's exact rate <= B5's on that stratum
gates.G3b_CROSS_MODE_MECHANISM_IDENTIFIABILITY: protocol §7(1): at least one mechanism Holm-significantly load-bearing in >= 2 modes; reported regardless of any residual
gates.G4_INTERFACE_LADDER: per mode, never pooled: monotonicity; significant steps and decisive rung reported per mode; positive interface-standard test = monotone AND rung1 significantly worse than rung5 AND M/B5 equivalence within the margin, in every mode
gates.G5_CHANGED_VOCABULARY: one mode-blind ORION-free rule set through per-mode adapters recovers the responsibility class >= 0.90 in every mode; shuffled-label null <= 0.35 where n >= 100 (else NOT_ESTIMABLE); 3x3 cross-adapter matrix reported

ladder_composition_policy_rungs_1_to_4: withhold when a witness-level module defeats every family, when any anonymous module reports DEFEATS_ALL, or when the number of anonymous defeating modules is at least the number of families the witness-level modules left standing; censoring via the optimistic/pessimistic bracket
limitations: the common decision object is a design input, not a finding; the three modes share authorship
no independent adjudication: protocol §11 R2 is not grantable by this study

an exact planner is optimal by construction in all three modes; the numeric modes remove Boolean-parent optimality only; the honest null terminal is 'no residual detectable in a registered decision problem the parents already solve exactly'
the oracle shell and the arms' compositions are two implementations of one decision format; agreement is necessary, not sufficient

balanced design: the twelve strata are planted identically in all three modes, so ladder differences can only arise where the native rules differ; not comparable to cross-study generator variation (ME-X1 R4->R5; ME-X4 R1->R2 and R3->R4)
synthetic ORION-authored episodes with registered outcome tables

dependence.FORMAL: any shared confirmed lemma or axiom merges two proofs (hard defeat)
dependence.MEASUREMENT: shared systematic source or ancestor correlates channels; systematics add linearly within a source group and in quadrature across groups
dependence.SYNTHESIS: overlapping cohorts are deduplicated to the largest report

identity.MEASUREMENT: fiducial restriction of the same observable is a narrowed commitment
identity.SYNTHESIS: identity over intervention/comparator/outcome only; population is a transport question

scope.FORMAL: a single artefact must carry the registered scope
scope.SYNTHESIS: union of the studies' population coverage

transport.FORMAL: a ported lemma requires ISOMORPHIC regardless of the family's declared minimum

outcomes.pooling_rule: every gate is evaluated per mode; a pooled average never routes anything on its own
outcomes.primary: decision-triple exact match (action, locus, authority), reported per mode

pre_freeze_inspection.purpose: verify runtime and gate estimability at n=480 per mode

statistics.mde_per_mode: 7 one-directional discordants of 480 (1.5%) give p=0.0156, surviving Holm at alpha/3
statistics.test: exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs
